expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===3 && R[0].min==='1' && R[0].max==='12' && R[0].step==='0.5' && R[1].min==='10' && R[1].max==='200' && R[1].step==='10' && R[2].min==='10' && R[2].max==='200' && R[2].step==='10' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three sliders: U 1–12 V by 0,5; R1 and R2 10–200 ohm by 10
two selects: connection yksi/sarja/rinnan and speed hidas/normaali/nopea
DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='R1,R2,U,mode' && P.U.unit==='V' && P.R1.unit==='Ω' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares mode, U (V), R1 and R2 (ohm)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?600:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x600 (larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows R in ohm, currents in mA and voltages in V
